nom: celimax Derma Nature Fresh Blackhead Jojoba Cleansing Oil

avis.titre: Documented a week...don't like it BUT the toner......Documented a week...don't like it BUT the toner......
avis.texte: First two pictures are before. Then two pictures for after. So on and so on, as the days go by. Then video will be at end of two week showing the 2 weeks after shot. I will use a different cleanser everyday as well. 1st use: Only 3 stars for now!! I started using this today. I'm going to use for a 2 week period. It's an oil-based cleaner. It does clean mascara off. It washes off easy. It was surprisingly a very clean feeling without drying you out. So, I will also use different make-up brands to test this product. Used with Biore Warming at 1st use. Next will be Noxzema and I always use CeraVe lotion. P.S.: I have Autoimmune disorders and I have sensitive skin. So we will see. Also, My order was dropped at the wrong address. Different city. The seller made it up to me when I received it. Which, even mailed incorrect, the seller sent the order fast! UPDATE: Okay I'm doing "after" pictures for each day. Sadly, I'm not seeing a difference in blackheads. I've never seen oil clean so damn well. It is a wonderful cleanser that has helped with blemishes(definitely) and it leaves your face feeling clean. Not dry or oily. It's a good concept for cleansers. I'm just saddened due to the fact it did NOT do anything to my blackhead. My original cleanser is still my favorite and on Amazon for $4.54. It's a warming Biore wash. I have found this works best. Due to the fact I've done the test for a week and it has not helped me with blackheads. I was really rooting for it bc the seller was so
Amazing! Effectively removes ALL my makeup and daily grime, while also feeling light and refreshing. Gentle, non-greasy, hard working
So worth it! It melted away all my blackheads & makeup (you have to use it on dry skin and massage in for 1-2 minutes). Just trust me, get this stuff!
I was surprised to find that it does work! there is a fragrance which doesnt bother me but im sure might be irritating to some with sensitive skin , just an fyi.
Se siente limpia la piel pero no veo que saque los puntos negros

I'm not sure why this doesn't have more buyers and reviews. I have tried quite a few cleansing oils and highly rated cleansing balms but this is by far my favorite. This is an amazing cleansing oil and smells like a dream. Cuts through my layers of makeup and setting spray with ease and then leaves my skin super soft. Have repurchased a few times and will explore their others products too. Repurchasing is kind of a big deal for me because I always want to try something new, but so far nothing else has worked as well.
Espectacular lo amé desde el primer día de uso. Deja mi rostro súper limpio, sedoso, suave y muy radiante. Y lo mejor de todo, es súper rendidor. Le daría 10 🌟 pero solo me permite 5 👌 😉 Mil Gracias!

avis.titre: Jojobalı yağ bazlı temizleyici. Korenin en iyi markalarından biri olan Celimax. Orijinal ürün.
avis.texte: Kore kozmetik markalarının en iyilerinin başında gelen Celimax'in çift aşamalı temizlik ritueli için alınacak yağ bazlı temizleyicisi. Jojoba yağı içeriyor. Özellikle yaz aylarında güneş kremi kullanımı arttığı için bunu arındırmada oldukça başarılı. Ürün orijinal. 1 günde teslim edildi. Harika bir satın alma deneyimi.
Sent bon, nettoie bien le maquillage, rend la peau douce, c'est magnifique. Ça aide à diminuer l'acné.
I already used half of the bottle … it’s such nice product for blackheads and whiteheads… it will clean ur skin so nicely and make ur skin texture better

After one wash my skin is noticeably smoother and even more even toned! I have really bad dark spots from acne but this product helped. I can't wait to see how my skin looks after a couple weeks if this is how it looks after the first time! It even removed this one stubborn blackhead that I've literally had for years! 😁

Esta es mi primera ver usando este producto. Es un jabón facial a base de aceite para la doble limpieza. La primera vez que lo apliqué en el rostro y lo esparcí al rededor de mi rostro sentí mi cara algo tibio, una vez pasan una par de segundos masajeando empecé a sentir un residuo como si fuese una arenilla.
